rules.full: base name; variant part in brackets. zh/ja full-width （）, en ' (...)' with a space before. Parts joined by '，' (zh), ', ' (en), '、' (ja). Never a middle dot (U+00B7 or U+30FB). Terror forms use the official '＊' pattern (en '*').
rules.short: chip label: the bracket content only; the base variant uses 原皮 (zh-CN), 原皮 (zh-TW), Original (en), 通常 (ja); Terror forms use the part after ＊.
